test_stimuli.name: init_and_frame_output
test_stimuli.derivation: Init sequence writes commands; frame output writes 0x21,0x22 then data bytes. No read-back, so frame_ok sentinel returns 0.

test_stimuli.name: frame_output_with_data
test_stimuli.derivation: Frame output writes column/page address commands then 128 bytes of data. frame_ok sentinel indicates success.
